name: Bloodroot Shield
text:
This wooden shield is an interwoven knot of still-living tree roots (Hardness 6, HP 36, BT 18).

Activate—Thirsty Roots 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

---

Effect You hold out the shield as the roots untangle themselves and launch forward, dealing 9d6 void damage to all creatures in a 60-foot line (DC 25 basic Reflex save save). On a failed save, a creature takes an additional 5 persistent,bleed damage. The shield regains a number of Hit Points equal to half the void damage dealt.
